open_points.subject: A30 registry_base_url validation
open_points.text: a missing or empty `REGISTRY_BASE_URL` stops it, while a non-empty one is accepted at start whatever its form
open_points.question: Is emptiness tested on the raw environment string or after normalization such as trimming whitespace?
options: Only a zero-length raw value is empty; whitespace-only values start successfully and fail Registry calls as `transport_error`.
Normalize first; a whitespace-only value is empty and stops start-up.
open_points.default_guess: Treat only the zero-length raw value as empty because every non-empty form is expressly accepted.

events: The host operator starts the service.
outcomes: Start-up succeeds; each Registry call fails as `transport_error`.
Start-up is refused because normalization makes the value empty.
witness.observer: The host operator and callers waiting for Registry-backed operations.

open_points.subject: A30 runtime settings loading
open_points.text: A deployment value is a row of `config.runtime_environment_variables` read only by `load_runtime_settings`, into a field of `RuntimeSettings`
open_points.question: How many times may `load_runtime_settings` read the environment during one process lifetime, and are the resulting settings an immutable start-up snapshot?
options: Read the environment exactly once during process start and retain one immutable `RuntimeSettings` object.
Permit later calls to reread the environment, producing settings that may differ within one process.
Read once per application instance created in the process.
open_points.default_guess: Read exactly once at process start and retain an immutable settings snapshot.

witness.initial: The service starts with `REGISTRY_BASE_URL=https://registry-a.example`; afterward the process environment is changed to `https://registry-b.example`.
events: The host or test harness invokes application construction or settings loading again.
A caller performs a Registry-backed operation.
outcomes: The operation still uses Registry A because settings are a one-time start-up snapshot.
The operation uses Registry B because `load_runtime_settings` rereads the environment.
witness.observer: The caller, Registry operators, and the host operator.

open_points.subject: 02_rules.md:Classification principles
open_points.text:
- a value that depends on the deployment (URLs, origins, hosts, size bounds,
  rate limits) — a row of the start-up table `config.runtime_environment_variables`,
  validated once at start by `runtime_settings` and read into a field of
  `RuntimeSettings`; the one exception is the two binary storage rows
  (`BINARY_STORAGE_ROOT`, `BINARY_MAX_READ_BYTES`), which have no field and
  which the emitted `binary_storage` reads at each read, as the Factory's
  binary storage backend is built (A14, A30).
open_points.rule: Таблица выше — исчерпывающий список путей значения, и у каждого из них своя форма: перечисление называется адресом, константа поставщика — `the imported X constant`, настройка — полем объекта настроек.
open_points.question: Make both deployment-dependent binary-storage values fields of the settings object and have generated code read those fields, or reclassify them into another permitted path.

open_points.subject: A30 binary_read_limit_env_name
open_points.text:
- `binary_read_limit_env_name`: the binary read limit is the environment
  variable `BINARY_MAX_READ_BYTES`, a required row of the start-up table that
  `load_runtime_settings` validates at start without a `RuntimeSettings`
  field; the emitted `binary_storage` reads it at each read through its
  backend IR (Factory `a6916180314d`). No model-written module reads it.
open_points.rule: Таблица выше — исчерпывающий список путей значения, и у каждого из них своя форма: перечисление называется адресом, константа поставщика — `the imported X constant`, настройка — полем объекта настроек.
open_points.question: Make `BINARY_MAX_READ_BYTES` a typed `RuntimeSettings` field populated by the settings module and require `binary_storage` to receive that field instead of rereading the environment.

open_points.subject: A30 Consequence
open_points.text: A deployment value is a row of `config.runtime_environment_variables` read only by `load_runtime_settings`, into a field of `RuntimeSettings` (`database_url`, `environment`, `public_origin`, `trusted_hosts`, `allowed_origins`, `max_request_body_bytes`, `max_binary_response_bytes`, `production_logging`, the two viewer-entry limits and, since 2026-11-09, `registry_base_url`), except the two binary storage rows, which the emitted `binary_storage` reads.
open_points.rule: Таблица выше — исчерпывающий список путей значения, и у каждого из них своя форма: перечисление называется адресом, константа поставщика — `the imported X constant`, настройка — полем объекта настроек.
open_points.question: Remove the exception and route both binary-storage environment values through typed fields of the settings object.
